info.desc: Scorpion is the fifth studio album by Canadian rapper Drake. It was released on June 29, 2018 by Young Money Entertainment, Cash Money Records and Republic Records. Scorpion is a double album consisting of 25 tracks. Its "A side" is primarily a hip hop album, whilst its "B side" has been described as R&B and pop. The album features guest appearances from Jay-Z and Ty Dolla Sign as well as posthumous appearances from Michael Jackson and Static Major, and additional vocals by a variety of artists, including James Fauntleroy, PartyNextDoor, Nicki Minaj, Future and Nai Palm. podcast.body: In 2018, Drake experienced his "most dominant chart year," scoring three Hot 100 number ones: "God's Plan," "Nice for What," and "In My Feelings." All three of these hits finished in the top 10 of Billboard's Songs of the Summer chart. "Drake's most dominant chart year was 2018 when he scored three hot 100 number ones, all of which finished in the top 10 of billboards songs of the summer chart."
